reference_sql:
SELECT ol.order_line_id, p.product_name, pr.promo_code
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
LEFT JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promo_id = ol.promo_id
WHERE CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-03-08'
alternatives: SELECT ol.order_line_id, p.product_name, pr.promo_code FROM order_lines ol LEFT JOIN promotions pr ON pr.promo_id = ol.promo_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-08' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-09'

SELECT ol.order_line_id, p.product_name, pr.promo_code FROM promotions pr RIGHT JOIN order_lines ol ON pr.promo_id = ol.promo_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id WHERE CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) = DATE '2025-03-08'
